title: High quality-first shipment a disappointment
text: I just received my first shipment tonight (Nov. 30) and am very impressed with the quality. The kit contains everything you need to make the card, including stamps, and stamp pad. The papers are good quality too.  Why the disappointment?  The first shipment makes sympathy cards!  Really?!  Less than a month before Christmas and my first shipment is a sympathy cards kit.  What a downer.  I would think someone in marketing would know to make a customers first kit for an upcoming holiday, birthday, Spring... anything cheery.  Even if they have to dig through previous years kits.  They should consider that for the next time sympathy cards are the next kit and they get new subscriptions.
label: neutral
